_comment: Captured live 2026-08-07 from a real Write in Claude Code (PLAN-multisession-marker-scoping ADR-005). A temporary dump was inserted into worktree_gate.main(), a Write issued, the payload recorded, and the dump reverted. Two facts this pins that code-reading got wrong twice ([fail:design] runtime-env-gate-dead-on-arrival, count:2): the caller's identity arrives as a top-level `session_id`, and there is NO `workspace` key — so a gate keyed on `workspace.current_dir` resolves nothing. Values below are redacted placeholders; the KEY SET is the contract.
